changelog.summary: /raven-sync approved all 34 requirements.txt libraries (33 newly added, 0 blocked by CVE) after fixing a sync-libraries.py crash (already_approved() assumed approved_skills was a dict of library tiers; it is a flat list of skill names in this manifest schema). Same session: closed three Oracle-parity bugs found while testing the dev-rv-msi -> dev_oci merge against a real Oracle ADB (PRs #310-#314) -- shay_bridge_store.py's ON CONFLICT upserts (ORA-01407/ORA-00932/ORA-22848), OraclePool.connection() missing psycopg_pool's timeout kwarg, an OCI GenAI FK-judge prompt truncation, and a missing ARYX_CPQ_LAYOUT_DIR env var in docker-compose-oci.yml. Added docs/RAVEN_STYLE_COMPLIANCE_PLAN_2026-09-03.md (full-repo AST scan against this manifest's style thresholds) and three new architecture diagrams (docs/aryx_oracle_adb_architecture.html, docs/diagrams/technical-flow-oracle.html, docs/diagrams/cpq-engine-technical-flow.html).

Add oci (OCI SDK) and defusedxml to approved libraries — oci is used throughout the OCI backend (oci_client.py, oci_doc.py, llm_providers.py); defusedxml added in PR #12 for secure XML parsing. Update cloud from 'none' to 'oci' and add oracle-adb-23ai to data and db arrays to reflect the Oracle ADB 23ai backend introduced in the oci-backend-toggle feature.

Add fdk to approved libraries — OCI Functions Python runtime, installed only inside the aryx-ingest-fn Docker image (functions/aryx-ingest-fn/Dockerfile). Never installed in local dev or main requirements.txt. Approved by Raven review PR #6.

Confirm manifest gap intent vs dev baseline: (1) guard.infra.terraform_state and guard.firewall.open_world omitted — project has no Terraform and ports are bound by Docker not app code, so these guards are not applicable. (2) allowed_tools.web.blocked_url_patterns omitted — project uses Ollama exclusively, not OpenAI; no direct OpenAI call risk from skill code. (3) project_rules.commit_convention omitted — conventional commits are followed by convention, not enforced via manifest pre-commit hook in this branch. (4) pool-fitter, auth-warden, block-smith, survivor-smith added to approved_skills — these are registered gap-closure skills in the org skill registry.
Bump raven_version to 3.3.0 to match main — was regressed to 3.0.0 by auto-init
Restored guard thresholds, style rules, approved_skills, full library list, and work_type — all stripped in v1.0.0 auto-init
